Notice to End your Tenancy
Because the Landlord, a Purchaser or a Family Member Requires the Rental Unit
N12
To: (Tenant's name): Fatima Al-Sayed
From: (Landlord's name): Peter Lindqvist
Address of the Rental Unit: Basement apartment, 15 Woodbine Crescent, Toronto, Ontario
This is a legal notice that could lead to you being evicted from your home.
The following information is from your landlord
I am giving you this notice because I want to end your tenancy. I want you to move out of your rental unit by the following termination date: 30/11/2026.
Reason 1: The following person intends to move into the rental unit and occupy it for at least one year: My child.
Important Information from the Landlord and Tenant Board (LTB)
The termination date the landlord sets out in this notice must be at least 60 days after the landlord gives you this notice. Also, the termination date must be the last day of the rental period.
The landlord must: Pay you an amount equal to one month's rent by the termination date in this notice, or Offer you another rental unit that is acceptable to you.
Signature: Landlord  Signature Date: 15/09/2026
